established.method: Fault injection, not revert: nodeAddedPayload is a new exported symbol, so the pre-change world cannot compile a test that imports it. Replaced the conditional options spread with an unconditional 'options: created.options' (raw JSON string, present even when null) and re-ran refresh-tests --file app/lib/mapStore.test.ts, then restored it.
established.evidence: 2 of the 4 nodeAddedPayload tests went red under the injected fault: 'omits the optional fields entirely when they are absent' and 'returns options as an array, not the JSON string the column holds'. The other two ('carries the identity a reader needs', 'includes provenance and the settled assumption when present') correctly stayed green, since the fault only affects the options key. Run d499dd06-3ee6-4d59-802f-c0efe9f4f70b reported 5 failed / 76 passed; suite returned to 81/81 green after restoring.
